text:
Tori Nguyen: FYI I hit a 404 for the curl example image in docs/runtime/quickstart.md while testing the quickstart. Anyone owns that page?
docs-bot: Link-scan alert (1825005555): 404 asset detected in docs/runtime/quickstart.md (around line 45). Auto-ticket DOC-1309 created.
Sam Blake: Can you paste the URL? Ill check the archive.
Tori Nguyen: Image: https://cdn.redwood.ai/illustrations/rt-quickstart-step3.png
Tori Nguyen: curl -I output:
```
$ curl -I https://cdn.redwood.ai/illustrations/rt-quickstart-step3.png
HTTP/1.1 404 Not Found
Date: Mon, 20 Jan 2025 08:14:00 GMT
```
Kai Morgan: Looks like that asset was never migrated from the older shortlink namespace. Design might have the original export. Sam, want me to ping design-uploads?
Sam Blake: Yes please. For small items we usually rehost in docs-site/static/images/ and add a frontmatter custodian like `custodian: runtime-docs` so the scanner knows who to ping.
Tori Nguyen: Rehosting sounds fine. Quick ask: please update alt text to "Runtime quickstart step 3 (diagram)" for clarity.
Sam Blake: Opening PR now. sed I used to swap the link:
```bash
sed -i 's|https://cdn.redwood.ai/illustrations/rt-quickstart-step3.png|/static/images/rt-quickstart-step3.png|g' docs/runtime/quickstart.md
```
docs-bot: PR #4012 created and linked to DOC-1309.
Kai Morgan: Design confirmed archived SVG, giving reuse permission.
Sam Blake: Deploy preview: https://deploy-preview-4012.docs-site.redwood.ai/runtime/quickstart — image loads and alt text updated. PR body includes changelog: "Rehost rt-quickstart-step3 image; add custodian: runtime-docs."
Tori Nguyen: Verified preview. LGTM. Thanks for the quick turnaround.
Sam Blake: Merged and closed DOC-1309. Closing thread.
Kai Morgan: Added a one-liner at top of quickstart: "Found broken content? Ping #docs or open a DOC ticket (scan auto-creates them)."
Tori Nguyen: Perfect, closing. :tada:
